description: A conditional selecting the dynamic value returns it unconverted
notes: The spec unifies the dynamic pseudo-type and number to number, and converting the dynamic value to number gives an unknown number. hashicorp/hcl skips unification when either result has the dynamic pseudo-type and returns the selected result unconverted (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go). An implementation whose unknown values are all dynamic would pass regardless, hence typed-values.
